name: Zacess Warm Dark
description: Cream on warm dark brown with earthy amber, rust, olive and teal, a gentler theme for anyone who finds high contrast too intense.
toml:
# the Zacess Warm Dark theme as a profile, one of the ten starter profiles
# colours from the Zacess themes palette 0.12.1
# a gentler pair: the themes hold it to a 4.5:1 text floor rather than 7:1, so the profile states
# the same floor and is checked against it

spec_version = 1
name = "Zacess Warm Dark"
id = "zacess-warm-dark"
description = "Cream on warm dark brown with earthy amber, rust, olive and teal, a gentler theme for anyone who finds high contrast too intense."
appearance = "dark"

[needs]
reduce_motion = true
cursor_size = "standard"
focus_ring_width_px = 2

[needs.contrast]
text = 4.5
non_text = 3.0
overlay = 4.5
terminal = 4.5
terminal_dim = 4.5
highlight_distance = 0.08
colour_vision_distance = 0.04
tone_difference = 0.05

[needs.font]
family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono"
fallback = "monospace"
size_pt = 14

[palette]
background = "#211b17"
foreground = "#e5d5b6"
surface = "#1a1512"
surface_alt = "#2c241f"
muted = "#cabca9"
border = "#988c7e"
accent = "#e9b56a"
accent_foreground = "#211b17"
link = "#e9b56a"
focus_ring = "#e9b56a"
cursor = "#fec9a7"
cursor_text = "#211b17"
selection_background = "#7abad3"
selection_foreground = "#211b17"
selection_soft = "#2c465c"
line_highlight = "#36322d"
error = "#fca8a1"
warning = "#fac97c"
info = "#aad3f1"

[palette.syntax]
keyword = "#f69d74"
control = "#ffafc0"
function = "#ffe8a1"
type = "#71c0b6"
variable = "#e5d5b6"
parameter = "#ffd1ad"
property = "#a4c9e9"
string = "#abba6f"
number = "#ecb4d8"
comment = "#beb19e"
operator = "#e5d5b6"
tag = "#f89b7b"
attribute = "#ffce9f"
regex = "#a6e3cd"
invalid = "#ffb1aa"
added = "#94be7d"
removed = "#ffb1aa"
changed = "#b6dbfc"

[palette.terminal]
ansi = [
    "#ada398", "#fc9a8d", "#a2be6f", "#e4b35b",
    "#88b9e3", "#dfa1ca", "#73c2b8", "#cbc1b1",
    "#b9b1a9", "#fee4e0", "#d9f2b0", "#ffe9b6",
    "#d7ecff", "#ffe1f4", "#b1f7ed", "#fbf1dc",
]

check.output:
pass profiles/zacess-warm-dark.toml (Zacess Warm Dark)
     224 pairs against text 4.5:1, non-text 3:1, overlay 4.5:1, terminal 4.5:1 and dim terminal 4.5:1, with paired colours 0.05 apart in tone and 0.04 under colour vision deficiencies
     tightest syntax.type #71c0b6 on selection_soft #2c465c: 4.63:1
